scientific_integrity: The exact identities are proved mathematically and cross-checked by independent direct enumeration. Earlier general run-balancing results are credited and not presented as original. Results have not received external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to binary linear strings of Hamming weight two and exact t-deletion sets. Uninspected full text of the 2008 Mercier–Khabbazian–Bhargava paper leaves a literature-priority risk.
title: Exact two-marker deletion-sphere law and fixed-composition mean
